transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because at night, once I start eating, it’s like I can see myself doing it and I’m telling myself to stop… but I don’t. My hands just keep going back for more, and it feels like I’m not really in control of it.
Does this loss of control happen to you when you eat during the day as well, or is it mostly at night?
It’s mostly at night. That’s when it really happens—once I start eating, I’m telling myself to stop, but I just keep reaching for more anyway. During the day, I don’t notice it the same way.
Is there a particular type of food that you tend to lose control with at night?

It’s not really one food. Some evenings I’ll start with leftovers, and then it turns into sandwiches, cereal, cookies… whatever snack food is in the pantry. It ends up being way more than I’d ever put on a plate for a normal supper.
Do you feel guilty or ashamed after these nighttime eating episodes?
I don’t know if I’d call it ashamed exactly. I mean, I don’t feel good about it afterward. I usually think, “Why did I do that?” But I’m not sure beyond that.
Have you experienced any issues with your sex life?
I’m not sure how to answer that. I haven’t really noticed a specific problem there, or at least nothing I’ve been thinking of as connected to all this.
Do you ever feel sexually aroused when you're eating at night like this?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed any sexual feeling tied to it. It’s more like I’m just eating and not stopping.
Have you noticed any significant weight gain since these nighttime eating episodes started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been tracking my weight closely, so I can’t say I’ve noticed a significant gain.
Do you ever feel sexually aroused when you're eating in general?
No, I haven’t noticed that. Eating doesn’t feel sexual to me—it’s just eating, as far as I can tell.
Do you enjoy the taste of the food when you're eating at night like this?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I can taste it, but I don’t think I’m sitting there enjoying it much. It’s more like I’m just eating, kind of on automatic.
Do you usually feel stressed, anxious, or upset before these nighttime eating episodes start?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern like that. Sometimes I might be a little tense, but I can’t say it always happens because I’m stressed or upset.
Do you think you might be eating at night as a way to cope with feelings or emotions?
I don’t really know. I haven’t thought of it that way. It might be, but I can’t say I’m aware of eating at night because of feelings or emotions. It just kind of happens.
Do you think your nighttime eating might be related to trying to manage or deal with emotions?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really connected it to emotions in my mind. It may be part of it, but I can’t say I notice, like, “I’m upset so I eat.” It just seems to happen.
Have you noticed any decrease in sexual activity or satisfaction around the same time these nighttime eating episodes started?
I haven’t really noticed a clear change like that. I mean, I can’t say my sexual activity or satisfaction dropped around the same time. It’s not something I’ve connected with the nighttime eating.
Do you feel like you have to continue eating once you start at night, even if you don't want to?

Yes. That’s actually the main thing bothering me. Once I start eating at night, I can be thinking, “Stop, you don’t need more,” but I still keep going back for more anyway. It feels like I’m watching myself do it and not really able to stop.
Do you think your eating at night could be related to sexual issues or a lack of sexual activity in any way?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t noticed any connection between the night eating and sex or lack of sex. It just doesn’t seem related to me, at least not that I can tell.
Do you feel an intense urge to eat at night that you can't ignore?
Yes. Once I start eating at night, it’s like I know I should stop, and I’m telling myself to stop, but I still keep reaching for more. It’s hard to ignore in the moment.
Do you feel like you're eating at night because you feel compelled to, rather than because you're hungry?
Yes. A lot of the time it doesn’t feel like real hunger. It feels more like I’m compelled to keep eating. I can be telling myself, “Stop,” but my hands just keep going back for more anyway.
Do you think your nighttime eating might be a way for you to deal with or escape from feelings or emotions?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t clearly noticed it being about escaping feelings. Sometimes I’m stressed or tired, sure, but I can’t say that’s the reason I eat at night. It just kind of happens.
Do you feel that eating at night is in any way related to sexual pleasure for you?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything sexual about it. It’s more just eating, not tied to pleasure in that way.
Do you feel any sexual pleasure when you eat at night?
No, I don’t feel sexual pleasure from it. It’s not like that for me.
